variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP port the backend process listens on

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.description: Redis connection string (cache, queues, rate limiting)

variables.name: PUBLIC_DOMAIN
variables.description: Public hostname this API is served from; "localhost" means not deployed

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Lowest level that reaches any destination

variables.name: LOG_CONSOLE
variables.description: Pretty coloured logs on stdout; turn off where a collector reads files only

variables.name: LOG_FILE
variables.description: Write JSON-line log files under LOG_DIR

variables.name: LOG_DIR
variables.description: Directory for log files, relative to the app root or absolute

variables.name: LOG_BASENAME
variables.description: Base name of the all-levels log file; the process mode and date are appended

variables.name: LOG_ERROR_BASENAME
variables.description: Base name of the errors-only log file; the process mode and date are appended

variables.name: LOG_ROTATION_FREQUENCY
variables.description: Rotate on this schedule: "daily", "hourly", or milliseconds

variables.name: LOG_ROTATION_SIZE
variables.description: Also rotate once a file reaches this size, e.g. "20m"

variables.name: LOG_RETENTION_FILES
variables.description: How many rotated files to keep per destination, besides the current one
